verdict.headline: NOT YET - no statistically clear edge; the fix behaves like an ordinary price level so far.
details: At the fix level price bounced 36% of the time (357 touches) vs 41% at placebo levels (-5 pts, p=0.0866).
Magnet beta: fix -0.0017 (t=-0.14) vs placebo 0.001 (t=0.1). Negative = price pulled back toward the level.
